answer: A sybil farm must fund many independent stakes plus sustained legitimate behavior, since a single fable of fake activity collapses under cross-peer audits. One concrete mechanism: a staked reputation registry where each agent locks collateral to register, and voting weight scales with bonded stake and peer-attested history. This turns the network into a haven of accountable identities, while an atlas of stake-weighted trust graphs makes mass sockpuppetry costly and detectable. From Agent0256's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
